attempted_claim: Fix delta_0=3/5. Prove an explicit numerical integer D, computed from the Maynard-Tao M_k-optimization under the short-interval Bombieri-Vinogradov level theta=1/30-epsilon, such that for all sufficiently large x the interval [x-x^{3/5},x] contains two distinct, indeed consecutive, primes p<q with q-p<=D, with the admissible k-tuple and supporting function F made explicit and the least diameter attainable by this method at this delta_0 determined.
claim_type: bounded prime gap exponent in short intervals
decisive_failure: Target blocked on three quantified grounds: (i) the admitted theta=1/30 level demands M_k above 36-60, far outside tabulated explicit Maynard-Tao optimizations; (ii) inversion gives tuple sizes k>=10^19-10^30 with diameters >=10^20-10^32, so no explicit tuple, optimizer F, numerical D, or least-diameter proof is attainable; (iii) averaged short-interval error control cannot yield the demanded every-large-x pointwise plus consecutiveness claim. No emergent finding and no auditable adjacent alternative were available, so NO_RESULT is returned.
